sources.title: RFC 6241: Network Configuration Protocol (NETCONF)
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: RESTCONF：ETag 樂觀並行與遺失更新
related.titleEn: RESTCONF: ETag concurrency and lost updates
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：第5項研究的可複查條件：接受及時確認才成永久狀態；遲到確認不得假裝回溯生效。 交接時須能核對：交付 netconf-transactions.csv、快照hash與斷線後回復測試。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 review criterion: Permanent state requires timely confirmation; a late confirmation must not be treated as retroactive. Handover must also reconcile: Deliver netconf-transactions.csv, snapshot hashes and disconnect-rollback tests.
related.difference: 以resource、read ETag、write If-Match、current ETag與status建立交易表。
related.differenceEn: Record resource, read ETag, write If-Match, current ETag and response status for each transaction.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
NETCONF confirmed-commit可在未確認時回復組態；候選資料通過驗證不等於已永久提交。
教學基準：100+180-160 = 120 s margin；對照：100+180-300 = -20 s margin。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。

RESTCONF可使用HTTP條件請求避免覆蓋已改變資料；讀取與寫入之間的版本必須匹配。
教學基準：8/50*100 = 16 %；對照：2/50*100 = 4 %。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
NETCONF confirmed commit can roll back unconfirmed changes; validated candidate data are not a permanent commit.
Teaching baseline: 100+180-160 = 120 s margin; comparison: 100+180-300 = -20 s margin. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.

RESTCONF uses HTTP conditional requests to avoid overwriting changed data; read/write versions must match.
Teaching baseline: 8/50*100 = 16 %; comparison: 2/50*100 = 4 %. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Shannon AWGN 鏈路：頻寬與功率預算
related.titleEn: Shannon AWGN link: bandwidth and power budgets
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：第5項研究的可複查條件：接受及時確認才成永久狀態；遲到確認不得假裝回溯生效。 交接時須能核對：交付 netconf-transactions.csv、快照hash與斷線後回復測試。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 review criterion: Permanent state requires timely confirmation; a late confirmation must not be treated as retroactive. Handover must also reconcile: Deliver netconf-transactions.csv, snapshot hashes and disconnect-rollback tests.
related.difference: 能推導並解釋4000000 bit/s與2000000 bit/s，建立capacity.csv、SNR單位表、容量反算表，並完成以下驗收：第二組若需求3 Mbit/s則模型已否決；第一組僅通過必要容量檢查，仍需實測效率。
related.differenceEn: Derive and explain 4000000 bit/s and 2000000 bit/s; create capacity.csv, an SNR unit table and inverse-capacity checks; apply this acceptance decision: A 3 Mbit/s demand fails the second bound; the first passes only a necessary capacity check and still needs efficiency evidence.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
NETCONF confirmed-commit可在未確認時回復組態；候選資料通過驗證不等於已永久提交。
教學基準：100+180-160 = 120 s margin；對照：100+180-300 = -20 s margin。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。

從原理 高斯加性白雜訊模型的容量為 B log2(1+S/N)；S/N 必須是線性比，容量上界不等於實際吞吐。 展開基準式 1000000*log2(1+15)；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：把 C/B 還原為 2^(C/B)-1，分別得到15與3；另記編碼、導頻及封包開銷尚未納入。 將兩條推導一起存入 capacity.csv、SNR單位表、容量反算表。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
NETCONF confirmed commit can roll back unconfirmed changes; validated candidate data are not a permanent commit.
Teaching baseline: 100+180-160 = 120 s margin; comparison: 100+180-300 = -20 s margin. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.

Starting from For an AWGN channel C=B log2(1+S/N); S/N is linear and the bound is not application throughput., expand baseline expression 1000000*log2(1+15); record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Invert using 2^(C/B)-1 to recover 15 and 3; coding, pilots and packet overhead are not yet included. Save both derivations with capacity.csv, an SNR unit table and inverse-capacity checks.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
